origine_fr: La bouche 口 et 于 (yú), qui donnait le son mais ne donne plus xū. Le souffle sort de la bouche : s'étonner, soupirer, 长吁短叹. Lu yù, c'est appeler à, 呼吁.
origine_en: The mouth 口 and 于 (yú), which gave the sound but no longer gives xū. Breath leaving the mouth: to be astonished, to sigh, 长吁短叹. Read yù, it means to appeal, 呼吁.

phrase.fr: Il a tant couru qu'il est hors d'haleine.
phrase.en: He ran until he was out of breath.
